nodes.name: perk-base-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Defines base damage, heal, hit-count, scaling, and poise constants for every perk and weapon art in Voxel Blade (Dragon Claw, Dragon Bubble, Springblast, spirit summons, Pyre Bloom, Ichor Spark, etc.), mirroring the game's Perkbasedmg.ts values for use by the damage engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Large flat list of SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE exported constants grouped per perk with comment headers.

nodes.name: perks.ts
nodes.summary: Provides tuning constants for perk mechanics — percent bonuses per stack, proc chances, crit-damage and crit-rate multipliers, divisor values, and element lists such as Wild Bolt elements — consumed by the damage engine to apply perk modifiers.

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: Defines localStorage keys, the complete default build state, compact save-format key maps with generated inverses, and UI constants (max build slots, confirm timeout) used to persist and restore user builds.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses compact two-letter key maps with reverse maps generated via Object.fromEntries over Object.entries.

nodes.name: dmgTypes.ts
nodes.summary: Defines BADGE_CONFIG, a UI display map of perk proc badges (colors, labels, tooltips), and the core damage interfaces ComputedType, PerkOnHitDmg, and ComputedHit used by the engine to represent per-hit damage breakdowns.
